description: S52 T2 (LM2): the stamp reverses. restore clears the INSTANT (retractedAt is gone — the row is live again and every default read will answer with it); what the last retraction said (reason, by) survives beside the row as recent history, and changed:true says this call is the one that moved it. An already-live id answers changed:false, writing nothing — the same honest idempotence as retract.
